supervision_coordinate_convention: Native transform_image_to_crop; rounded centre, constrained to the representable 0..15 grid; same-state diagnostic precedes restart
loss: Native raw focal + 2 GIoU + 5 xyxy L1 + weight-1 competition at the rounded GT cell against up to 9 raw-score hard negatives with detached decoded center outside GT and IoU<=0.1. Plus weight-1 reliable same-state native spatial KL.
invalid_gt: No loss; advance the predicted crop/query/template state normally.
target_centre_outside_crop: All-zero centre heatmap and no box regression; no GT reset or widened crop.
state_protocol: Initialize from first RGB-D/box only; chronological full sequence; actual predicted boxes, queries and default template updates feed the next frame. Optimizer updates every 32 observed frames with valid-loss averaging. State tensors are detached.
caption_protocol: Frozen local Qwen2.5-VL first-frame full image with target mark plus target crop; no sequence/category hint; raw automatic captions retained, including observed errors.
checkpoint_retention: One latest and one fixed final adapter+optimizer per arm; no base copy or per-epoch history.
optimizer_stop_conditions: Non-finite loss/gradient, source mismatch, runtime exception; preserve terminal evidence.
hypothesis: Preserving GT-supported same-state native spatial behavior during causal language adaptation may reduce native-success damage while retaining lexical gains.
architecture_control: Identical M78 t0 full-forward protocol, source tree, zero initializer, seed2027, banks, sequence order, optimizer and tracking/Raw competition losses. Only training adds a read-only native decode and reliable spatial KL. No new inference parameters.
selection_protocol: Only fixed seed2027 category final; no additional seeds or checkpoint selection.
text_control: Both use_text=True and five original slots/mask/padding. Category uses original slot0 plus empty attributes. Empty replaces every valid slot with the same CLIP empty embedding. No new caption or embedding.
monitoring: Check initial coverage about 240 seconds after launch; later near estimated completion. Preserve errors and do not restart on observation timeout.
scope_limitations: Fixed seed2027; reused Train development22, no random seed variance estimate.
Same-state teacher is not an independent native recursive trajectory.
Spatial normalization does not preserve absolute update confidence or guarantee long-term safety.
GT is used only after current prediction for training supervision; no teacher gating at deployment.
M78 controls are sealed matched historical runs; no checkpoint selection, no automatic external evaluation.
after_training: Seal Category, independently trained Empty, same Category head Empty and Swapped trajectories before any metrics. All four run irrespective of gate outcomes.
promotion_gate_scope: Ten native/paired-Empty gates retained; eight fixed-head content gates; four Category incremental gates vs matched M78 all required for a preservation improvement claim. Four Empty incremental gates descriptive. No cumulative historical success-protection gate.
preservation_teacher: Already computed native raw score; native Hann-decoded clipped bbox on exactly the student current crop/template/query, before public state commit. Detached, never committed.
preservation_eligibility: Training only, after public prediction: valid GT, target centre in crop, same-state native decoded bbox continuous rectangle IoU>=0.5.
preservation_distribution: Raw positive clamped Center Head sigmoid scores normalized over 256 spatial positions; KL(teacher||student), spatial sum and batch mean, weight 1; no /256 and no temperature.
incremental_gate_definition: Category pooled mean and macro no less than matched M78 Category, low frames and H10 no more; corresponding Empty comparison descriptive.
independent_review_status: REVIEW_UNAVAILABLE: prior gpt-6-astra/max quota rejection remains in force until 2026-09-12; no new call, substitution or claimed review.
